targets.title: Knowledge Transfers from Multinational to Domestic Firms: Evidence from Worker Mobility.
targets.evidence_quote: This paper replicates Poole (2013) using comprehensive Norwegian and Irish register data.
targets.outcome_quote: Our re- sults largely confirm the evidence documented in Poole for Brazil which suggests that when workers leave multinationals and are rehired at domestic establishments, the wages of their new coworkers who have already been present in the establishment increase. However, unlike suggested in the original article there is little indication that these spillovers differ in a statistically significant way across various dimensions of heterogeneity for any of the three countries.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Wage spillovers agree, but authors explicitly contrast the absence of heterogeneity with the original. The general confirmation concerns the main wage effect and is qualified by contrasting tested findings. Brazilian results are taken from published estimates rather than a re-analysis of original data.

reasoning: Identity verified from title, DOI and three authors in full 30-page article including references and appendix. One finding paper is targeted; other citations provide background or methods.
